info.name: KeralaGO API Collection (Dual Auth & Production Ready)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection covering 100% of KeralaGO APIs.

Includes:
- Dual Authentication (MSG91 SMS/Widget + Gmail SMTP Email)
- Explicit Sign In (`mode: LOGIN`) vs Registration (`mode: REGISTER`)
- Automatic JWT Bearer Token Extraction & Propagation (`{{jwtToken}}`)
- Customer Aggregated Dashboard, Wallet & Saved Places
- Fare Estimation Engine & Dynamic Coupons
- Complete 4-Stage Ride Lifecycle
- Driver Partner Suite (GPS Beacon, Duty Toggle, Vehicle Documents, Earnings)
- Safety, Emergency SOS & Grievance Tickets
- PostgreSQL & HTML DB Visualizer

request.description: Checks backend connectivity and returns database status and engine version.
Interactive HTML dashboard to inspect all users, drivers, vehicles, rides, and wallets.
Authenticates user by mobile number or email. Returns JWT Bearer token and automatically updates {{jwtToken}}.
Directly registers a new user into PostgreSQL, creates UserProfile, and automatically sets {{jwtToken}}.
Sends login OTP to existing mobile user. Returns 404 if user is not registered.

item.name: Send OTP - Sign In (Email / Gmail SMTP)

request.description: Sends live 4-digit login verification email to inbox via Gmail SMTP.
Registers new user with Full Name and Mobile Number. Dispatches challenge code.
Sends new account registration code to email address via Gmail SMTP.

item.name: Verify OTP & Auto-Save JWT Bearer Token

request.description: Verifies entered OTP and returns user profile session and JWT token. Automatically saves {{jwtToken}} to collection variables!
Completes registration and creates User and Profile in PostgreSQL.
Fetches profile directly using the JWT Bearer token in Authorization header.
Updates full name, email, and payment preferences in PostgreSQL database.
Fast 1-tap login endpoint for testing demo accounts without OTP challenge.
Returns full aggregated data for customer app: profile, wallet balance, saved places, vehicle categories, and recent trips.
Retrieves trip history with stops, vehicle details, fares, and ratings.
Updates customer preferences (quiet ride, AC preferred, cashless only).

Uses Haversine distance and FareConfig to calculate prices across Auto, Hatchback, Sedan, SUV, EV.

Validates promo code and calculates discount amount and final fare.
